name: Overseer
title: Overseer Disk Cage
note: Layout v5 / cage v5 (26-27 Oct, Spark: the v2 drone with a triangulated shell formed to it; the L2 and the two cameras (27 Oct: no down camera, the pair beside the L2) outside it with nothing in their views, on 3 rods to the cage; funnel redesigned later) from nox/overseer/layout_v5.py; supersedes layout v4 / cage v2. Rough layout: C geometry on E sizes. Drone frame: x fwd, y left, z up, z 0 bottom plate top.
